observations.rule: RFC 6265 cookie storage/replacement uses matching name, domain and path; PHP setcookie exposes those attributes.

optionAudit.clear-httponly: Changes access policy but not path identity.
optionAudit.clear-secure: Changes transport policy but not path identity.

observations.rule: Apply nonblocking stream behavior together with the explicit no-EOF/no-error and no-busy-spin requirements.

optionAudit.complete: Prematurely marks an incomplete stream as complete.
optionAudit.wait: Retains partial state and uses readiness/deadline control.
optionAudit.reconnect: Discards the existing stream’s progress without evidence of a broken connection.

observations.rule: Composer optimized class maps allow PSR-4 fallback for misses; authoritative maps do not. The file is explicitly created after every stated build-time scan.

optionAudit.more-classmap: The future file remains absent from the scan.
optionAudit.apcu-plus-authority: Caching does not reverse authoritative class-map semantics.
optionAudit.optimized-fallback: Keeps level-one optimization and restores the required fallback.
optionAudit.repeat-authoritative-build: The repeated scan still occurs too early.

observations.expectedError: Cannot assign int to property Reader::$read of type Closure

observations.rule: RFC 9110 distinguishes safe methods from idempotent methods; GET is safe while a deliberate archival mutation is not.

optionAudit.query-decides: Input placement does not determine safety.
optionAudit.unsafe-action: Preserves the distinction between requested mutation and repeated effect.
optionAudit.auth-decides: Authorization does not change method semantics.

observations.expectedError: Typed property LazyNumber::$number must not be accessed before initialization

observations.rule: PHP documents uniqid as unsuitable for cryptographic purposes and random_bytes as a cryptographically secure byte source.

optionAudit.hash-hardness: Candidate inputs can be generated and hashed without inverting a digest.
optionAudit.secure-source: Uses the documented cryptographic source and a reversible textual encoding.
optionAudit.longer-hash: Digest choice does not improve input entropy.

observations.rule: PHP documents filter_input as reading original raw input supplied by the SAPI before userland changes to superglobals.

optionAudit.current-array: Confuses original request data with the current userland array.
optionAudit.input-removed: Array assignment does not remove the original input.
optionAudit.untrusted-mutation: No such mutation-detection failure is specified.
optionAudit.original-snapshot: Uses the original 1; filter_var is the appropriate API for the current 2.

observations.rule: PHP identifies HTTP_ entries as request-header-derived server variables; the scenario explicitly lacks a server Host allowlist.

optionAudit.server-container: Provenance depends on the entry, not the superglobal name.
optionAudit.tls-guarantee: TLS does not provide the absent application Host policy.
optionAudit.syntax-sufficient: A well-formed attacker-selected hostname remains unauthorized.

observations.expectedError: You can only iterate a generator by-reference if it declared that it yields by-reference

observations.rule: Apply the stated modern-browser SameSite policy and PHP setcookie attribute meanings; no real cookie is sent.

optionAudit.lax: Top-level exceptions do not cover this subresource request.
optionAudit.none-insecure: Fails the required Secure attribute rule.
optionAudit.none-secure: Meets all stated delivery and script-access requirements.

observations.rule: Unaccepted bytes must have no public serving path; scanning is asynchronous and mandatory.

optionAudit.publish-delete: Has an exposure window before rejection.
optionAudit.quarantine: No public path exists until acceptance.
optionAudit.extension: Public storage serves the pending filename.
optionAudit.mime-first: Format checking is not scanner acceptance.

observations.rule: Composer --no-dev skips require-dev; require dependencies remain installed.

optionAudit.dev: Excluded by the specified install mode.
optionAudit.require: Declares and locks the runtime dependency.

observations.rule: Unbuffered input and a nonretaining synchronous sink permit bounded retention only if intermediate stages do not collect the whole export.

optionAudit.incremental: At most current row and encoding are retained.
optionAudit.fetch-all: The complete input array remains retained.
optionAudit.collect-lines: The complete encoded output array grows.

observations.rule: Only the three specified nonsensitive metadata values are required; future request fields must be excluded by default.

optionAudit.digest: Credential-derived values are still recorded and may be guessable.
optionAudit.failure-only: Failure status does not remove secrets.

observations.rule: Unique immutable IDs ordered descending; new rows receive only higher IDs; continuation must exclude the delivered cursor row.

optionAudit.offset: Prepending shifts offsets and repeats old rows.
optionAudit.keyset: Strictly smaller IDs are exactly the remaining range.
optionAudit.newest: Selects the wrong side of the cursor.

observations.rule: RFC 8725 requires algorithm verification and appropriate key use; this issuer permits only RS256 with its pinned RSA verification key.

optionAudit.header-select: Lets an attacker expand the permitted algorithms.
optionAudit.fixed-policy: Enforces the configured algorithm and key association.
optionAudit.family: Key ID equality does not make a different algorithm valid.

observations.rule: Without a class-patching extension, loading the same fully qualified class again does not replace it; OPcache invalidation concerns cached script bytecode.

optionAudit.replace-workers: New process obtains new definitions at a safe boundary.
optionAudit.invalidate: Existing objects and loaded definitions are unchanged.
optionAudit.reconstruct: Creates an object of the still-loaded old definition.

observations.rule: On the stated local POSIX flock filesystem, locks refer to open files; rename/unlink can separate old open objects from later opens of the same pathname. Publication must remain within one shared critical section.

optionAudit.data-lock: A waiter on the old data object and a new opener of the replacement can acquire different locks.
optionAudit.release-before-publish: Schedule B’s read between A’s unlock and rename: B computes from stale state.
optionAudit.unlink-after-unlock: B opens the old sidecar before A unlocks/unlinks; C creates a new sidecar, permitting independent locks.
optionAudit.stable-lock: A and B share one retained sidecar and each publishes before releasing it.
